messages:
maria: Morning — finalizing Thu release train. Need an owner for the 09:00 PT slot (web + api, maybe a small migration). We need smoke owners + rollback lead. Target canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. 09:00 PT = 16:00 UTC. Reply with role you can take. cc @sre-oncall :wave:
alex: I can take 09:00 PT and run the deploy for web + api. Plan: build -> canary 5% (10m) -> 25% (15m) -> 100%. I'll run the smoke checklist and watch latency. :thumbsup:
chris: I can own API smoke checks with alex. I'll validate traces + error budget dashboards. What about migrations?
alex: Only a tiny index add behind a flag — no long locks. Migration is quick; I can run it during canary. Script:
```bash
psql $PROD_DB -f migrations/2026-03-add-index.sql
```
Plan to run migration at 09:05 PT (right after first canary cut).
tunisha: I can own frontend smoke (UX flows + critical paths). I'll prepare 5 check requests and a short script. Where should I post results?
achris: post to the release thread and ping me if any 500s show up. I'll check /api/v1/health, /graphql query sample, and top traces.
jordan: I'll be rollback lead for DB if the migration behaves weirdly. My rollback is: 1) rollback migration (if reversible) OR 2) flip feature flag + traffic-shift back to previous API service. Need a 30m window reserved for rollback actions.
sre-oncall: I'll be on-call during the window. If latency or errors spike above thresholds, I'll coordinate immediate traffic-shift. Add SLO alert runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/slo-incident
alex: Thanks — I'll put the smoke checklist inline before deploy and tag owners. Quick checklist:
- preflight: CI green, canary image built, infra health OK
- deploy: cut canary, run smoke scripts (tunisha/chris), run migrations (alex)
- monitor: latency, error rate, logs, traces (sre-oncall)
- rollback: jordan owns DB rollback or feature-flag flip
I'll put the deploy command in the pipeline and notify deploy-bot when ready.
deploy-bot: Reserved deploy window 2026-03-12T09:00:00-07:00 for alex (slot id: 2187654321). :white_check_mark:
maria: Perfect. Can everyone confirm they can join the thread at the start time? If someone is remote, please ensure a backup.
chris: Confirmed. I'll be online and watching traces.
tunisha: Confirmed. I'll run the frontend smoke scripts and post pass/fail.
jordan: Confirmed. I'll be reachable for rollback steps.
sre-oncall: Confirmed — I'll keep an eye on alerts and be ready to route traffic.
maria: Great. I'll update the release calendar and add the owners. If anyone needs to swap, please update this thread by EOD Wed. :calendar:
